from pathlib import Path
import math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SRC=Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB')
W,H=SRC.size

# Source geometry observed in the supplied frame.
FRUIT_BOX=(120,82,138,113)              # dragon fruit and its natural table shadow
FRUIT_CENTER=(129,98)
PLATE_CENTER=(100,105)
WRIST=(202,164)                         # off-frame center of the rigid right wrist
HAND_POLY=[(161,86),(178,83),(198,123),(211,160),(154,160),(145,120)]

# Restore the table behind the moving fruit with neighboring real wood texture.
def make_background():
    bg=SRC.copy()
    # A similarly grained clean table strip from immediately to the right.
    patch=SRC.crop((139,80,158,116)).resize((19,36),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)
    bg.paste(patch,(120,80))
    # Remove remaining pink edge pixels conservatively using row-wise wood samples.
    a=np.array(bg)
    src=np.array(SRC)
    for y in range(80,117):
        for x in range(118,141):
            r,g,b=src[y,x]
            if r>85 and r>g*1.28 and r>b*1.14:
                xx=min(159,max(140,x+21))
                a[y,x]=src[y,xx]
    return Image.fromarray(a)
BG=make_background()

# Keep real arm pixels: an RGBA cutout with soft anti-aliased boundary.
def arm_layer():
    mask=Image.new('L',(W,H),0)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    d.polygon(HAND_POLY,fill=255)
    # Include the wrist/controller body all the way to the lower edge.
    d.polygon([(177,119),(213,111),(256,143),(256,160),(174,160)],fill=255)
    mask=mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.65))
    a=np.array(mask)
    rgba=np.dstack([np.array(SRC),a]).astype(np.uint8)
    return Image.fromarray(rgba,'RGBA')
ARM=arm_layer()

# Original fruit sprite; edge matte follows pink/green object rather than its rectangle.
def fruit_sprite():
    crop=SRC.crop(FRUIT_BOX)
    arr=np.array(crop)
    h,w=arr.shape[:2]
    alpha=np.zeros((h,w),np.uint8)
    # Hand-tuned silhouette, preserving dragon-fruit crown and scales.
    pts=[(8,0),(10,5),(14,2),(13,8),(17,7),(16,13),(18,17),(16,25),(13,30),
         (7,31),(2,27),(0,22),(1,17),(0,13),(4,12),(3,7),(7,8)]
    m=Image.new('L',(w,h),0); ImageDraw.Draw(m).polygon(pts,fill=255)
    m=m.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.55)); alpha=np.array(m)
    return Image.fromarray(np.dstack([arr,alpha]).astype(np.uint8),'RGBA')
FRUIT=fruit_sprite()

def ease(t):
    t=max(0,min(1,t)); return t*t*(3-2*t)

def paste_center(im, sprite, center):
    x=int(round(center[0]-sprite.width/2)); y=int(round(center[1]-sprite.height/2))
    im.alpha_composite(sprite,(x,y))

def arm_pose(angle_deg):
    # Rotation about fixed wrist base makes the embodied arm rigid, not deforming.
    return ARM.rotate(angle_deg, resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC, center=WRIST, expand=False)

def fingertip(angle_deg):
    # Forward kinematics of source fingertip (129,92) around fixed wrist.
    a=math.radians(angle_deg); x,y=FRUIT_CENTER[0]-WRIST[0],92-WRIST[1]
    return (WRIST[0]+math.cos(a)*x+math.sin(a)*y,
            WRIST[1]-math.sin(a)*x+math.cos(a)*y)

def fruit_at(t):
    # 0-4 approach; 5 grasp; 6-15 carry left/up; 16-19 lower/release.
    if t<=5: return FRUIT_CENTER
    if t<=15:
        u=ease((t-5)/10)
        # smooth, stable carry to plate center with a modest lift toward the camera
        return (FRUIT_CENTER[0]+(PLATE_CENTER[0]-FRUIT_CENTER[0])*u,
                FRUIT_CENTER[1]-4*math.sin(math.pi*u)+(PLATE_CENTER[1]-FRUIT_CENTER[1])*u)
    return PLATE_CENTER

def angle_at(t):
    if t<=4: return 42*ease(t/4)
    if t<=5: return 42
    if t<=15: return 42+(25-42)*ease((t-5)/10)
    if t<=17: return 25
    return 25*(1-ease((t-17)/2))

def make_frame(i):
    if i==0: return np.array(SRC,dtype=np.uint8)
    im=BG.convert('RGBA')
    angle=angle_at(i)
    fc=fruit_at(i)
    carrying=(i>=6 and i<=17)

    # Contact shadow remains on table before pickup; carried fruit has a softer offset shadow.
    shadow=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H),(0,0,0,0)); sd=ImageDraw.Draw(shadow)
    if i<=5:
        sd.ellipse((fc[0]-8,fc[1]+9,fc[0]+10,fc[1]+15),fill=(25,20,18,65))
    elif carrying:
        sd.ellipse((fc[0]-7,fc[1]+10,fc[0]+9,fc[1]+15),fill=(22,18,17,38))
    shadow=shadow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(3.0)); im=Image.alpha_composite(im,shadow)

    if i<=5:
        paste_center(im,FRUIT,fc)
        im=Image.alpha_composite(im,arm_pose(angle))
    elif carrying:
        # Fingers wrap in front of the fruit: rear arm, fruit at the gripper, then dark contact pads.
        im=Image.alpha_composite(im,arm_pose(angle))
        paste_center(im,FRUIT,fc)
        pads=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H),(0,0,0,0)); pd=ImageDraw.Draw(pads)
        pd.ellipse((fc[0]-10,fc[1]-4,fc[0]-6,fc[1]+9),fill=(8,10,12,235))
        pd.ellipse((fc[0]+6,fc[1]-4,fc[0]+10,fc[1]+9),fill=(8,10,12,235))
        im=Image.alpha_composite(im,pads.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.35)))
    else:
        # Fruit stays stably on the plate while the right arm retracts.
        paste_center(im,FRUIT,fc)
        im=Image.alpha_composite(im,arm_pose(angle))

    return np.array(im.convert('RGB'),dtype=np.uint8)

frames=np.stack([make_frame(i) for i in range(20)])
assert np.array_equal(frames[0],np.array(SRC))
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)

    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

from pathlib import Path
import math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SRC=Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB')
W,H=SRC.size

# Source geometry observed in the supplied frame.
FRUIT_BOX=(120,82,138,113)              # dragon fruit and its natural table shadow
FRUIT_CENTER=(129,98)
PLATE_CENTER=(100,105)
WRIST=(202,164)                         # off-frame center of the rigid right wrist
HAND_POLY=[(161,86),(178,83),(198,123),(211,160),(154,160),(145,120)]

# Restore the table behind the moving fruit with neighboring real wood texture.
def make_background():
    bg=SRC.copy()
    # A similarly grained clean table strip from immediately to the right.
    patch=SRC.crop((139,80,158,116)).resize((19,36),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)
    bg.paste(patch,(120,80))
    # Remove remaining pink edge pixels conservatively using row-wise wood samples.
    a=np.array(bg)
    src=np.array(SRC)
    for y in range(80,117):
        for x in range(118,141):
            r,g,b=src[y,x]
            if r>85 and r>g*1.28 and r>b*1.14:
                xx=min(159,max(140,x+21))
                a[y,x]=src[y,xx]
    return Image.fromarray(a)
BG=make_background()

# Keep real arm pixels: an RGBA cutout with soft anti-aliased boundary.
def arm_layer():
    mask=Image.new('L',(W,H),0)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    d.polygon(HAND_POLY,fill=255)
    # Include the wrist/controller body all the way to the lower edge.
    d.polygon([(177,119),(213,111),(256,143),(256,160),(174,160)],fill=255)
    mask=mask.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.65))
    a=np.array(mask)
    rgba=np.dstack([np.array(SRC),a]).astype(np.uint8)
    return Image.fromarray(rgba,'RGBA')
ARM=arm_layer()

# Original fruit sprite; edge matte follows pink/green object rather than its rectangle.
def fruit_sprite():
    crop=SRC.crop(FRUIT_BOX)
    arr=np.array(crop)
    h,w=arr.shape[:2]
    alpha=np.zeros((h,w),np.uint8)
    # Hand-tuned silhouette, preserving dragon-fruit crown and scales.
    pts=[(8,0),(10,5),(14,2),(13,8),(17,7),(16,13),(18,17),(16,25),(13,30),
         (7,31),(2,27),(0,22),(1,17),(0,13),(4,12),(3,7),(7,8)]
    m=Image.new('L',(w,h),0); ImageDraw.Draw(m).polygon(pts,fill=255)
    m=m.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.55)); alpha=np.array(m)
    return Image.fromarray(np.dstack([arr,alpha]).astype(np.uint8),'RGBA')
FRUIT=fruit_sprite()

def ease(t):
    t=max(0,min(1,t)); return t*t*(3-2*t)

def paste_center(im, sprite, center):
    x=int(round(center[0]-sprite.width/2)); y=int(round(center[1]-sprite.height/2))
    im.alpha_composite(sprite,(x,y))

def arm_pose(angle_deg):
    # Rotation about fixed wrist base makes the embodied arm rigid, not deforming.
    return ARM.rotate(angle_deg, resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC, center=WRIST, expand=False)

def fingertip(angle_deg):
    # Forward kinematics of source fingertip (129,92) around fixed wrist.
    a=math.radians(angle_deg); x,y=FRUIT_CENTER[0]-WRIST[0],92-WRIST[1]
    return (WRIST[0]+math.cos(a)*x+math.sin(a)*y,
            WRIST[1]-math.sin(a)*x+math.cos(a)*y)

def fruit_at(t):
    # 0-4 approach; 5 grasp; 6-15 carry left/up; 16-19 lower/release.
    if t<=5: return FRUIT_CENTER
    if t<=15:
        u=ease((t-5)/10)
        # smooth, stable carry to plate center with a modest lift toward the camera
        return (FRUIT_CENTER[0]+(PLATE_CENTER[0]-FRUIT_CENTER[0])*u,
                FRUIT_CENTER[1]-4*math.sin(math.pi*u)+(PLATE_CENTER[1]-FRUIT_CENTER[1])*u)
    return PLATE_CENTER

def angle_at(t):
    if t<=4: return 42*ease(t/4)
    if t<=5: return 42
    if t<=15: return 42+(25-42)*ease((t-5)/10)
    if t<=17: return 25
    return 25*(1-ease((t-17)/2))

def make_frame(i):
    if i==0: return np.array(SRC,dtype=np.uint8)
    im=BG.convert('RGBA')
    angle=angle_at(i)
    fc=fruit_at(i)
    carrying=(i>=6 and i<=17)

    # Contact shadow remains on table before pickup; carried fruit has a softer offset shadow.
    shadow=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H),(0,0,0,0)); sd=ImageDraw.Draw(shadow)
    if i<=5:
        sd.ellipse((fc[0]-8,fc[1]+9,fc[0]+10,fc[1]+15),fill=(25,20,18,65))
    elif carrying:
        sd.ellipse((fc[0]-7,fc[1]+10,fc[0]+9,fc[1]+15),fill=(22,18,17,38))
    shadow=shadow.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(3.0)); im=Image.alpha_composite(im,shadow)

    if i<=5:
        paste_center(im,FRUIT,fc)
        im=Image.alpha_composite(im,arm_pose(angle))
    elif carrying:
        # Fingers wrap in front of the fruit: rear arm, fruit at the gripper, then dark contact pads.
        im=Image.alpha_composite(im,arm_pose(angle))
        paste_center(im,FRUIT,fc)
        pads=Image.new('RGBA',(W,H),(0,0,0,0)); pd=ImageDraw.Draw(pads)
        pd.ellipse((fc[0]-10,fc[1]-4,fc[0]-6,fc[1]+9),fill=(8,10,12,235))
        pd.ellipse((fc[0]+6,fc[1]-4,fc[0]+10,fc[1]+9),fill=(8,10,12,235))
        im=Image.alpha_composite(im,pads.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.35)))
    else:
        # Fruit stays stably on the plate while the right arm retracts.
        paste_center(im,FRUIT,fc)
        im=Image.alpha_composite(im,arm_pose(angle))

    return np.array(im.convert('RGB'),dtype=np.uint8)

frames=np.stack([make_frame(i) for i in range(20)])
assert np.array_equal(frames[0],np.array(SRC))
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
PY
